title: Projects redesigned: from folder to conversation
summary: Claude Projects was redesigned from a folder-based system to a conversation-driven workflow where a coordinator manages multiple parallel worker threads and automatically handles merge conflicts. Users set project goals and maintain shared memory of context across sessions, enabling long-running, multi-session builds with remote steering and no manual handoffs.

title: Claude Cowork and chat are now one Claude
summary: Claude Cowork and chat merged into a unified platform featuring Claude Docs and Slides (beta), plus integrated Claude Design. Users can create documents, presentations, and designs without leaving the chat interface, with outputs downloadable as PowerPoint, PDF, or other formats.

title: Bringing Salesforce into Claude
summary: A new beta Salesforce plugin brings 37 skills to Claude for sales teams—account research, call prep, pipeline review, and CRM updates—with daily briefings, deal scoring, and post-call summaries. The integration respects existing Salesforce permissions and early adopters report significant time savings on administrative work.

title: Working at the frontier: How Balyasny Asset Management evaluates and governs Claude Fable 5
summary: Balyasny Asset Management's Chief AI Officer discusses deploying Claude Fable 5, showing how agentic capabilities cut multi-day workflows to hours and scoring 89.4% on proprietary financial tasks. The interview highlights critical governance practices—data boundaries, tool permissions, and human review—for high-stakes financial AI use.

title: Claude for Small Business launches new workflows, integrations, and training programs
summary: Claude for Small Business now includes 43 workflows and 27 new integrations (Shopify, Salesforce, Gusto), enabling automation of lead generation, proposal writing, financial reconciliation, and content planning. The company is launching a fall tour with free workshops and partner webinars across 10 US cities.

title: How healthcare organizations use Claude Tag
summary: Claude Tag is a Slack-integrated AI agent enabling healthcare organizations to automate alert triage, internal tool maintenance, and compliance workflows with per-channel PHI restrictions. Insight Health achieved 97% automation of alert triage using Claude Tag, and enterprises linking it to GitHub receive $25,000 in credits through October 1, 2026.
